title: fix(studio): explain each control the field inspector locks in display-patch mode
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSoAeFWE57GxG3dEVs9Yx86)_

Fixes #28986

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 字段检查器在「只能改显示属性」模式(只读基础包的字段，经配对的 `.custom` 包定制)下，每个被锁住的控件(API 名、类型、必填/唯一、默认值、选项值与颜色、跟踪历史、三个条件规则编辑器、上移/下移、删除等)外面多了一层可 Tab 聚焦的包装：悬停或键盘聚焦时弹出提示，读屏通过 aria-describedby 读到顶部那句「此字段属于已安装的包：你只能修改它的……」。可编辑的标签、描述、帮助文本、占位符、选项标签不加包装、不带原因。
- **为什么改**:#28860 让基础包字段可以写显示补丁后，整栏的只读原因包装(objectui#12303)不再绘制，被锁控件变成灰着却说不出原因，`ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` 的回归行由 PASS 变 FAIL;这是 18.3.0 发版前的回归。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改检查器的渲染：新增的包装只在显示补丁模式下出现，普通可写字段和整栏只读两种情形 DOM 不变(各有对照测试钉住);不新增文案、不碰保存逻辑。代价是该模式下 Tab 序列里多了若干个停靠点(每个被锁控件或一行一组一个)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 的 `DisplayPatchLock` 与 `DisplayPatchReasonContext`,然后同文件 `OptionsEditor` 里选项值与选项工具条的包装;测试 `ObjectFieldInspector.displayPatchReason-28986.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.displayPatchReason-28986.test.tsx`,预期 1 个文件、16 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One lock, one reason.** `ObjectFieldInspector` gains a module-private `DisplayPatchLock`. In display-patch mode (`BaseFieldDisplayPatchContext` on, `readOnly` off) it wraps a locked control, or one row of them, in a `role="group"` tab stop with `data-disabled-reason`. `aria-describedby` on that wrapper points at the existing whitelist sentence at the top of BASIC (`field-base-patch-only`, which now carries an id), and a Radix tooltip shows the same sentence on hover and on focus. This is the shape `DeclaredActionsBar` (objectui#11811) and the read-only rail (objectui#12303) already use. In any other mode the lock renders its children unchanged.
- **What is wrapped:** API name, Type, the Required/Unique row, Default value, the picklist source, the related object and the lookup and related-list blocks, the formula editor, the summary block, the numeric and text-length grids, currency, value domain, the Read-only/Hidden/Track history row, the conditional-rules block, Field group, the header's Move up/down pair and the footer's Remove. Inside the options editor, each option's value input and its colour/kind/reorder/remove strip are wrapped, and a malformed row's controls too. Each option's label input is not.
- **The reason is provided above the shell.** `InspectorShell` draws the header and footer itself, so the inspector hands the reason through a context provided around the shell, and the options editor reads it from there too.
- **No new text.** The reason is the sentence the inspector already shows ("This field belongs to the installed package: you can change only its …"), which names the condition, so the checklist's specificity clause reads it as specific.
- **`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:** a comment only, at `fieldRailReadOnly`, saying where the reason for a base field's locked controls now lives. The rail's read-only wrapper is unchanged.

## Tests

- New `ObjectFieldInspector.displayPatchReason-28986.test.tsx` mounts the real inspector under the display-patch context, over six fields (text, select with options, lookup, number, formula, currency):
  - every control rendered disabled (attribute, `aria-disabled` or Radix `data-disabled`) sits in a `[data-disabled-reason]` wrapper with `tabindex="0"` whose `aria-describedby` resolves to the whitelist sentence;
  - every wrapper contains at least one disabled control (no empty tab stop), and Label, Description, Help text, Placeholder and each option label are enabled with no wrapper and no reason;
  - the card's named controls (API name, Required, Track history, a rule editor, every Move up, Remove, an option value) are each described by the sentence's id;
  - Tab reaches the API name lock and its tooltip shows the sentence; hovering the Required lock shows it too;
  - CONTROL: a writable field draws no lock and nothing disabled; a read-only rail (patch context on or off) draws no inner lock, since the host describes the whole rail.
- `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575.test.tsx` (the real Data pillar): the `required` case now also asserts the Required box's wrapper is a tab stop described by the sentence, and that the Label input has no wrapper.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live browser not measured.** The checklist row's oracle is the showcase boot in a real browser. This PR is verified in jsdom only. The wrapper is the same tab-stop-plus-tooltip shape the read-only rail uses, which the checklist's QA run measured PASS for hover and keyboard in Chromium; the next QA pass of `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` re-measures it here.
- **Tab stops.** One stop per locked control or row, and per option two (value, then the strip). That is the cost of keeping the editable controls undescribed between them.
- **Scope.** The external-object locks (`ddlLocked` from an external binding) keep their own badge and are unchanged.
